title: Scratch Beginner Challenge
description: A free Scratch challenge for kids aged 7 to 12. Build a talking pet, a catch game, a maze and a platformer, one step at a time.
intro: Start with a talking pet and finish with your very own platformer game. No experience needed, just a free Scratch account or the Scratch app.

steps.name: Make a talking pet
steps.mission: Build project 1, the Talking pet. When you click your sprite, it should say something and play a sound.

steps.name: Build a catch game
steps.mission: Follow the guide up to Step 6, so your game has a score, lives and a game over.

steps.name: Build a maze game
steps.mission: Draw a maze with walls and a goal, then add a timer so you can race against your best time.

steps.name: Boss level: build a platformer
steps.mission: This one is harder, so take your time and ask a grown-up or a friend to test it. Your player should jump, land on platforms and reach the goal flag.

title: Python Beginner Challenge
description: A free Python challenge for beginners aged 10 and up. Draw with code, build a guessing game, fix bugs and make your own small projects.
intro: Write your first real code by drawing with Python, then build games and learn to fix your own mistakes. Ready for Python after Scratch? This is the place to start.

steps.name: Draw with code
steps.mission: Draw a square using a loop, then make the colourful spiral.

steps.name: Build a guessing game
steps.mission: Finish the complete game from Step 7, and make sure a wrong answer like the word "banana" does not crash it.

steps.name: Become a bug hunter
steps.mission: Break your guessing game on purpose, then use the tips in this guide to find the problem and fix it.

steps.name: Boss level: two more projects
steps.mission: Build the dice roller, then rock, paper, scissors, without looking at the code more than you need to.

title: Web Beginner Challenge
description: A free web development challenge for ages 11 and up. Learn HTML, CSS and JavaScript by building a website, a navbar and a to-do app.
intro: Go from not knowing what HTML is to building a working app in your browser. All you need is a computer and a free code editor.

steps.name: Learn the three languages
steps.mission: Read the guide, then explain to someone in one sentence each what HTML, CSS and JavaScript do.

steps.name: Build your first website
steps.mission: Build your page up to Part 6, and check it on a small screen as well as a big one.

steps.name: Control your layout
steps.mission: Make the practice page and try Steps 1 to 5 until the boxes go where you want them.

steps.name: Add a navbar
steps.mission: Build the navbar and make sure the menu button works on a small screen.

steps.name: Boss level: a to-do app
steps.mission: Build the app up to Step 7, so your tasks are still there after you refresh the page.
